# Intuisity

Intuisity is a free daily intuition training app and personal growth platform.

## Official site

- https://www.intuisity.com/

## Main Topics

- Intuition training
- Awareness practice
- Mindfulness
- Synchronicity
- Inner wisdom
- Inner knowing
- Sixth sense development
- Remote viewing practice
- Daily astrology insights
- Manifestation
- Personal growth
- Spiritual awakening
- Self-discovery
- Treasure Chest friend challenges

## Description

Intuisity helps users explore intuition, awareness, insight, consciousness, mindfulness, synchronicity recognition, and inner wisdom through daily guided challenges. The app includes Treasure Chest friend challenges, hidden picture intuition games, remote viewing practice, daily astrology guidance, positivity prompts, and personal results tracking.
